summary: This RCA task correctly root-caused a false watchdog 'stall' escalation to a real bug in the live, git-untracked /opt/veridian/scripts/worker-entrypoint.sh: the periodic-checkpoint heartbeat was killed immediately after the main claude -p invocation returned but before the unbounded quality-gate/auto-fix phase, so last_checkpoint_at went stale during any long gate run and got misread as a stall. I read the live file directly (not just the self-report) and confirmed the fix is applied correctly and minimally: the premature kill/wait was removed with an explanatory comment, the pre-existing EXIT trap still reaps the heartbeat on every real exit path, and the unrelated kill inside the budget-cap hard-stop branch was correctly left intact. bash -n passes and the existing tests/worker_noop_pending_review_test.sh regression test still passes unchanged. The known_fixes sqlite row for signature 'periodic checkpoint' is genuinely registered. Because the fixed file lives outside any git repo, this workspace's own diff is legitimately empty (zero commits ahead, files_modified: []), which is why the task correctly checkpointed as a no-op pending_review rather than completed -- there is no repo-tracked PR content to merge here, so 'tier1 approve' functions as confirmation of a sound, verified fix rather than an actual git merge action.
